messages.subject: Removing/hidding data points in geom_point
parts:
Hi and thanks in advance,

I'm plotting a scatterplot with gam functions overlaying the datapoints

Here is the code I used:

###########
five.trt.plot<-ggplot(data=worm_eggs, aes(x=day, y=daily_egg_production,color=as.factor(both.diet.factors)))

# lets pretty it up a bit
five.trt.plot+ 
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank() )+geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(se=F, method='gam', formula=y~s(x, bs="cr",k=9))
##############

This produces a nice-ish graph (see attachment).

The Problem: I want to make the data point hidden so the graph only shows the gam curves.

Any thoughts?

Richard
